description:
A single TikTok video by URL or ID: caption, timestamp, like/comment/share/play/save counts, cover, duration, author and music.
Cost: 1 credit per successful call (failed calls are refunded).
Provide one of: `url` OR `video` OR `id`.
Returns: id (string), link (string, nullable), description (string), created_at (string, nullable), like_count (integer, nullable), comment_count (integer, nullable), share_count (integer, nullable), play_count (integer, nullable), save_count (integer, nullable), cover_url (string, nullable), dynamic_cover_url (string, nullable), duration (integer, nullable), author (object), music (object).

video.description: Alias of url (URL or ID). Example: "https://www.tiktok.com/embed/v2/6718335390845095173"

name: tiktok_video
title: TikTok video
